affected_rows: 0 rows carry a wrong figure; 1 printed row per Sarawak year is MISSING (the head itself)
defect: Sarawak prints a FOURTH revenue head, `Pemberian Kerajaan Persekutuan dan Bayaran Balik` (FY2020: 248.34), which is not emitted as a row. `revenue_total` (10,646.69) is correct, but tax + nontax + nonrevenue = 10,398.35 falls short by that head, so Sarawak's revenue components do not sum to its total.
diagnosis: Surfaced by the DOSM cross-check (sources/dosm/data/_crosscheck_state_finance_vs_audited.csv): DOSM reports Sarawak non-revenue receipts as 279.09, and 30.75 + 248.34 = 279.09 exactly - DOSM folds the head into non-revenue receipts, proving the printed head exists and our figure for it is right. The validator already uses it in the four-head reconciliation proof, so the head is recognised during checking but never written to the fact file.
why_unfixed: Needs a revenue-head row emitted under a conformed code (e.g. revenue_federal_grants) plus a decision on whether other states' equivalent heads conform to the same code - a dictionary change, not taken unilaterally. sources/dosm/pipeline/crosscheck_state_finance.py already carries the COMBINES entry that will re-adjudicate the DOSM comparison to DEFINITIONAL once the code exists.
impact_on_data: No figure in the panel is wrong. Do not derive Sarawak revenue by summing components; use revenue_total.

defect: Agency names weld across the three-line centred layout (`Majlis Bandaraya Ipoh Kumpulan Wang Biasiswa Bukan Melayu Perak`), one printed bil is absorbed into its neighbour, and EVERY row on the page reads `opinion=Tanpa Teguran`.
diagnosis: Two causes.  (a) The name cell is printed on the lines either side of its Bil., and where the Bil. line itself carries a name the per-column tie-break cannot separate them.  (b) `_OPGROUPS` has no pattern for this volume's captions `PENDAPAT TANPA TEGURAN DENGAN OM` / `... DENGAN EOM DAN OM`, so the opening `PENDAPAT TANPA TEGURAN` section heading is never superseded.
why_unfixed: (b) is a one-line addition but changes the opinion taxonomy for every state, which needs its own verified pass against the printed opinion captions; shipping it untested would silently re-tag opinions elsewhere.
impact_on_data: `opinion` and `opinion_qualifier` on this page are not trustworthy; `agency_name_bm` on this page is partly welded.  No other page of any state is affected.

defect: `Majlis Agama Islam Negeri Pulau Pinang` is not emitted.  The page prints two rows, each numbered `1.`, under two different opinion captions.
diagnosis: The second caption is typeset with wide inter-word gaps and wraps (`PENDAPAT TANPA   TEGURAN   DENGAN   PERENGGAN PENEGASAN PERKARA DAN PERENGGAN` / `HAL-HAL LAIN`), so its tail is not recognised as a heading and the two `1.` anchors collapse into one row.
why_unfixed: Recognising a heading that wraps across two lines needs the caption matcher to join header lines before testing, which risks swallowing genuine agency rows printed in capitals; not attempted without a verified sweep.
impact_on_data: One agency is missing from the FY2021 sijil register for Pulau Pinang.  The surviving row is correct.

affected_rows: unknown - a latent tokeniser defect, not a located row set
defect: A figure printed EXACTLY ONE SPACE after the previous figure is dropped by `lkan_state_parser._value_tokens`.
diagnosis: `_NUM_RE` allows one optional space after the sign, so when two figures are one space apart the scanner starts the second match ON that space; its preceding character is then the last digit of the first figure and the date / section-number guard discards it.  Seen on Sarawak CMD.43.2018 J4.14, where every row lost `27.5 25.8 35.2`.
why_unfixed: A global fix (trim leading white space before applying the guard) moved roughly 2,000 rows and broke column geometry (Pahang lost 63 rows), so it is applied only at ROW level (2026-11-05): column building keeps the historical tokeniser, and a row whose historical tokens do not fit the columns falls back to the exact ones (one per column, one per money-year column, or amount/share pairs in a `(RM Juta)`/`(%)` matrix).  That cleared every top-contributor JUMLAH defect (Selangor CMD.41.2019 J11 and CMD.50.2021 J13, Negeri Sembilan CMD.37.2018 J4.10); rows that still fit the columns with a value missing are not re-tokenised.
impact_on_data: Mostly percentage and PERUBAHAN columns, which are not extracted anyway.  Where it hits a money column the row is marked `column_geometry=incomplete_row`, so no figure is wrong - some are absent.

A rule sending a label-only line to the row ABOVE whenever every Bil. line carries label text fixed Sarawak J4.13 and Kedah J4.14 but broke Johor CMD.39.2021 J9, Kedah CMD.40.2021 J10 and stitched prose into two new Sabah CMD.41.2017 J4.9 rows, so it was reverted: the text layer alone does not say whether a wrapped line continues the row above or opens the row below.
why_unfixed: (a) is the line-at-a-time parser and a by-Bil. case that is not an exact tie; the glyph positions now used for (b) could place them too, a further change to every state's tables that needs its own verified pass; the phantoms and footer residue need the footer filter to recognise single footer words without eating real labels.
impact_on_data: No amount is wrong. The affected rows carry unconformed codes (not read by core or the gap view) except Johor J4.2 `public_trust_funds`, whose code is right. Do not quote these labels; the nil phantoms are 0.00 rows with no printed item.
